XOM (-55): Regulatory/legal headlines but price ABOVE TREND (1W: +4.52% | 1M: +14.24%) — sentiment diverging from price. RISK-OFF with a Value/Defensive tilt. UNH ABOVE TREND (1W: +5.10% | 1M: +9.56%), PG ABOVE TREND (1W: +4.55% | 1M: +5.98%) and AMD ABOVE TREND (1W: +13.93% | 1M: +20.81%) are showing relative strength. Key risk: MAJOR DIVERGENCE among large caps (MSFT RECOVERY, GOOGL CORRECTION, META RECOVERY) and mixed sentiment (GE/ABT/XOM) — monitor for confirmation before adding risk.
